content:
noah (product): Quick announcement: rolling out the Private Data Access Governance policy today for Private/VPC/on1rem customers. This defines tenant-level access controls, admin audit events, and a new customer-managed access key flow. Docs + customer pack: https://internal.redwood/docs/data-access-governance-v1. Please review and flag issues.

anya (security): Highlights: admin events are now logged by default (30d retention) and there's an option for customers to push signed admin-audit bundles to their own bucket. We added guidance for minimising staff access.

tom (eng): Tech note: to enable customer-managed access keys you need agent >=3.5 and the new `access_control: external_keys` flag. We'll also provide a shim for HSM-backed key rotation for air-gapped installs. Example snippet in docs.

iris (cs): Will CSMs need to request enablement per tenant, or is this on by default? Need to prep support scripts.

noah (product): Default: audit logging is ON for all Private tenants. Customer-managed key flow is opt-in and requires a signed attestation. CSMs should follow the enablement checklist in the doc.

deploy-bot: Doc deploy in progress: data-access-governance-v1 -> staging (CI #5177). ETA 1h. :file_folder:

luca (legal): Heads up: new policy introduces a template amendment for customers who want strict separation of admin roles. We added a short text block for SOWs and a mandatory disclosure for cross-border admin access (appendix D).

maya (sales): Need a short buyer-facing FAQ: will the new audit logs leak customer data? Also what does the enablement timeline look like for pilots?

anya (security): FAQ answer: audit logs are metadata-only by default (user, action, timestamp, resource id). Customers can opt to include request metadata but we redact payloads unless explicitly enabled with an attestation. Pilot enablement: we can onboard pilot tenants within 48-72 hours after signed attestation.

tom (eng): For air-gapped installs the HSM shim will generate rotation proofs locally; customers push signed rotation bundles to our verification tool. We'll add CLI examples in the doc.

iris (cs): Action items: I'll draft standard support templates and a short enablement checklist. Also will collect typical customer questions to feed the FAQ.

noah (product): Action list: @tom add CLI examples + shim instructions; @luca finalise amendment language; @anya give final security blurb for the FAQ; @iris produce CSM one-pager; @maya prepare AE talking points. Tracker: https://internal.redwood/tracker/DAG-01. Close here unless blockers. :white_check_mark:
